About the Butterlap group ride

A Wednesday night loop around San Francisco that starts at the Ferry Building. There are no leaders. The pace is relaxed and nobody gets dropped. Everyone is welcome.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
